_about: Write the Houdini hand-off for analysis layers (population and the like): site-model/houdini/handoff/. See the docstring of site-model/houdini/tools/export_handoff.py.
source: USGS 3DEP CA_LosAngeles_B23 (2023) LiDAR at full density with the Houdini labels (the same names as web/data/lidar_points.laz); entities, names and Assessor data from site-model/houdini/annotations/entities.json
axes: x = east, y = north, z = up (local, from the origin)
tiers_note: Each tier is a prism from 'base' (ground, 10th percentile under it) to 'top' (90th percentile of its 1 m roof cells); tiers are cut where roof heights jump more than 2 m and do not overlap. Only the part of a building inside the extent is included.

terrain.note: value at the centre of each cell; row 0 = north, column 0 = west; x0 / y0 = the NW cell centre
terrain.filled_cells: 0.3% had no points and take the nearest measured cell
